# hyperfluid_service_account_role (Resource)

Binds a role's permission bundle to a service account, organization-wide or narrowed by `scope_path`. Every argument forces a new binding. Requires `service_account:update` and `grant:read`.

`resource_type` cannot be read back from the API: it is kept as configured, and is null after import.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Service accounts are created in the console or with hfctl; Terraform
# references them.
data "hyperfluid_service_account" "ci" {
  client_id = "ci-deployer"
}

data "hyperfluid_role" "editor" {
  name = "editor"
}

# Organization-wide.
resource "hyperfluid_service_account_role" "ci_editor" {
  service_account_id = data.hyperfluid_service_account.ci.id
  role_id            = data.hyperfluid_role.editor.id
}

# Only for what lives under prod/.
resource "hyperfluid_service_account_role" "ci_deployer_prod" {
  service_account_id = data.hyperfluid_service_account.ci.id
  role_id            = hyperfluid_role.deployer.id
  scope_path         = "prod/*"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (String) Id of a role of the organization (`hyperfluid_role.id`, or the `hyperfluid_role` data source for a system role such as `viewer`).
- `service_account_id` (String) Id of the service account (the `hyperfluid_service_account` data source's `id`, not its `client_id`); service accounts are created in the console or with hfctl. A public-client account cannot hold a role: the API refuses it.

### Optional

- `resource_type` (String) Resource family of the bound resource, e.g. `secret`: only the role's permissions of that family apply. Requires an exact `scope_path`.
- `resource_uuid` (String) Id of the one resource `scope_path` names exactly. The binding then survives a rename of the resource and is removed with it. Requires an exact `scope_path`.
- `scope_path` (String) Path in the organization's resource tree the binding applies to: exact, an ancestor folder (covers what is beneath it), or a `*`-suffixed wildcard at a path boundary (`prod/*`). Omit for an organization-wide binding.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<service_account_id>/<role_id>[/<scope_path>]`, the import id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import id is "<service_account_id>/<role_id>" for an organization-wide binding,
# or "<service_account_id>/<role_id>/<scope_path>" (the scope path may contain
# slashes). resource_type cannot be read back and stays null after import.
terraform import hyperfluid_service_account_role.ci_editor 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111
terraform import hyperfluid_service_account_role.ci_deployer_prod '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111/prod/*'
```
